tools.name: list_modes
tools.description: List Reliclear modes available in the App UI and via tools (Enhance, Remove BG, Edit, Looks, Effects).

tools.name: enhance_photo
tools.description: Enhance a photo URL via Anna host image.edit when available. For local files prefer open_app_view('main') — UI uses local classical enhance.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of the source image (e.g. R2 download_url).

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove background from a photo URL via Anna host image.edit when available. For local files prefer open_app_view('main') — UI uses local rembg.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of the source image.

tools.name: remove_object
tools.description: Not available in this Reliclear release (desktop-only). Prefer enhance_photo, remove_background, or App UI Edit/Looks/Effects.
